scans_terminal_result_invariant.name: scans_terminal_result_invariant
scans_terminal_result_invariant.value: ("scans"."status" not in ('completed', 'partial')) or ("scans"."score" is not null and "scans"."coverage" is not null and "scans"."finished_at" is not null)

scans_failed_level_invariant.name: scans_failed_level_invariant
scans_failed_level_invariant.value: "scans"."status" <> 'failed' or ("scans"."score" is null and ("scans"."level" is null or "scans"."level" = 'incomplete'))
